title: Jupitice reimagines Digital Justice Infrastructure with an Ironclad ‘Trust Layer’ for AI-Native Legal Operations
description: Jupitice Justice Technologies, India's first and only Meta Product Platform built exclusively for the justice, legal, and governance ecosystem, has announced the formal integration of a comprehensive Trust Layer across all its AI-native products and operating systems. This quality assurance infrastructure, embedded before any software is delivered to a client, represents a significant leap forward in how legal technology companies should responsibly deploy artificial intelligence in high-stakes
